entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker from Zendikar who defends the tower, is judged by Gaea and the Worldsoul, and is filled with Gaea's wrath.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A fire planeswalker who wants all Phyrexians dead and who leaves for Kaladesh to visit her mother.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who guards Teferi and fights beside Nissa.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: Wrenn's partner tree who launches Nissa at the Phyrexian leader.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer whose Temporal Anchor is damaged when its powerstone implodes.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who says she understands how to activate the sylex and will get it to work.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who is stranded in the past, fading in the Anchor's capsule, and wakes whole on an unknown beach.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage planeswalker who arrives with allies and links the strike team telepathically.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor planeswalker invited by Jace to join the effort.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An archmage who survives the blast and stays to work on freeing Teferi.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who survives the blast and joins the strike team for New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: The Golgari queen who arrives to join the strike team.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: An elegant, fierce planeswalker who arrives with Kaito Shizuki.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A young man with a shorn head who arrives with the Wanderer.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A shirtless planeswalker who arrives to answer Jace's call.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A grizzled, distant planeswalker who joins the group.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: A planeswalker who waits on Dominaria as backup.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A fallen friend who is not coming.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A friend who died for the sylex.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A compleated leonin whom Nissa thinks about.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem who promised the spirits to take the sylex away.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor whose strategy to bind the planes to New Phyrexia drives the plan.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A rebel praetor nearly ready to attack.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer with whom Teferi spoke.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A planeswalker shoring up Innistrad's defenses with Arlinn.

entities.name: Arlinn
entities.description: A planeswalker working with Sorin.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A planeswalker hiding with Hazoret and Amonkhet's population.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet sheltering with Samut.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The name Dominaria's Worldsoul has chosen; it judges Nissa and fills her with wrath.

entities.name: Phyrexian general
entities.description: A winged Phyrexian commander of the white-armored legion, killed by Nissa with seed-bearing stabs.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders attacking the tower in waves.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The resistance planning an offensive on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group reassembling on Dominaria.

entities.name: Mechanical soldiers
entities.description: Saheeli's automaton garrison commanded by Nissa after Elspeth.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: The time machine that is wrecked when its powerstone implodes, trapping Teferi's connection.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: The relic Kaya wraps up for the strike team.

entities.name: Urza's tower
entities.description: The tower Nissa and Wrenn defend.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane under Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian home plane where the strike teams will go.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane.

events.summary: Nissa and Chandra discuss the situation with Kaya and Saheeli: Jace's alliance is gathering and the Mirrans are about to attack.
events.quote: Jace has it on good authority that the Mirrans are going to launch their offensive very soon,

events.summary: Kaya explains the Phyrexians' World Tree plan and says they need the sylex to destroy it.
events.quote: If the Phyrexians have created their own tree, we'll need something powerful to destroy it,

events.summary: Chandra says no cost is too high to destroy the Phyrexians, clashing with Nissa and Saheeli.
events.quote: My point is that destroying the Phyrexians is the most important thing. No cost is too high.

events.summary: Teferi appears and says he is ready, and Chandra later admits she wants all Phyrexians to die.
events.quote: I want them all to die. All of them.

events.summary: At night Nissa, Wrenn and construct guardians hold the tower hall against Phyrexians who cross the threshold.
events.quote: Over two dozen Phyrexians had met with similar fates in the tower hall

events.summary: A pillar of light scorches the sky and steam covers the vale, leaving Elspeth and Jodah's fate unknown.
events.quote: Suddenly, a pillar of light scorched the sky outside the tower like a sun ascending

events.summary: A second army of white-armored Phyrexians led by a flying winged general advances from the east.
events.quote: Out of the haze emerged a battalion of knights, more than a hundred strong

events.summary: Nissa commands the mechanical soldiers to meet the army, but nature spirits refuse her call and leylines are tangled.
events.quote: They recoiled at her presence.

events.summary: The constructs and Phyrexians clash, and the Phyrexians fight with unusual tactics, pinning the machines.
events.quote: The armies collided with sharp staccato thunderclaps.

events.summary: Nissa lends Wrenn and Seven her strength and Seven hurls her at the flying Phyrexian general, whom she stabs repeatedly with a seed-bearing sword.
events.quote: With each stab, she'd implanted a seed within the Phyrexian

events.summary: Nissa and the general fall, Seven catches her, but she is dragged down by Phyrexians and reaches into the ground for the Worldsoul, Gaea.
events.quote: Help! Help us! she called out

events.summary: Gaea's nature spirits call Nissa a meddler, then judge her and grant her power, filling her with the wrath of Gaea.
events.quote: Gaea has judged you

events.summary: Gaea's will transmutes fallen constructs and Phyrexians into heartwood warriors that pour onto the battlefield and push back the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Gaea's would-be destroyers now reassembled themselves

events.summary: Nissa kills the crippled Phyrexian general with vines, after Wrenn urges her to stop, deciding she must be decisive when the time comes.
events.quote: The vines obeyed her command.

events.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
events.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

events.summary: Wrenn warns them not to disturb the capsule where Teferi is fading across time; Kaya says she can get the sylex to work.
events.quote: Teferi's chord is still tethered to this device,

events.summary: Jodah and Elspeth stagger in alive; Elspeth announces she will go to New Phyrexia and Jodah will stay to free Teferi.
events.quote: Then I'm coming with you.

events.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
events.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

events.summary: Jace links the strike team telepathically, and Nissa finds a tiny artifact bird, resolving to keep watch for every plane.
events.quote: For the life of every plane,

events.summary: Teferi wakes whole on a beach, cut off from Kaya and the Anchor, and starts to walk inland.
events.quote: He was no longer a spirit.

relations.quote: she and Seven stood in the middle of the tower's great hall

relations.note: Close friends who clash over the Phyrexians.
relations.quote: Why were things always so difficult between them, no matter how much they cared for each other?

relations.note: Nissa stabs and then strangles the general with vines.
relations.quote: Nissa closed her eyes and clenched her fingers tight.

relations.note: Nissa is granted Gaea's wrath after being judged.

relations.quote: I tried to hold it together, but the strain was too much.

relations.note: Kaya maintained contact with Teferi during the anchor's operation.
relations.quote: It took everything I had just to maintain contact.

relations.note: Jodah stays to free his friend.
relations.quote: If I let that happen, he'd never let me hear the end of it.

relations.note: Jace calls the group to leave and links the team.
relations.quote: Jace announced that the time had come to leave
